qa_pairs.question: What information does the CPU graph in the Metrix portal provide?
qa_pairs.answer: The CPU graph in the Metrix portal displays the CPU cores requested by a user over time.

qa_pairs.question: Are there any viewing options or limitations for the CPU graph in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, users can select specific cores to view on the right side of the CPU graph. However, it is important to note that this graph is not available for very short jobs.
